items.t: Said she will continue working to expand addiction treatment opportunities, ensure local law enforcement have adequate resources, and increase prevention programs to combat the opioid crisis.
items.q: I will continue to work diligently to expand treatment opportunities for those struggling with addiction, ensure local law enforcement have adequate resources, and increase prevention programs to combat the ongoing opioid crisis in Ohio.

items.t: Said she was almost brought to tears by the level of hateful rhetoric and the lack of humanity she saw at the congressional hearing.
items.q: I was almost brought to tears just now because the rate and level of hateful rhetoric … the lack of humanity … I am shocked,” she said.

record.t: Introduced bipartisan legislation to abolish the death penalty in Ohio and replace it with a life sentence without parole.
record.q: State Reps. Nickie J. Antonio (D-Lakewood) and Niraj Antani (R-Miami Township) today called for an end to capital punishment in Ohio and introduced bipartisan legislation to abolish the death penalty and replace it with a life sentence without parole.

record.t: Sponsored Senate Bill 20, which designates the first week of May as Ohio Stroke Awareness Week.
record.q: Senate Bill 20 , sponsored by State Senators Nickie Antonio (D-Lakewood) and Nathan Manning (R-North Ridgeville), designates the first week of May as "Ohio Stroke Awareness Week.

record.t: Served as House Democratic whip and as chair of the Ohio House Democratic Women's Caucus.
record.q: State Rep. Nickie Antonio is the former House Democratic whip and past chair of the Ohio House Democratic Women’s Caucus.

record.t: Was recognized for her work on the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee to improve quality of care and health outcomes for people enrolled in Medicaid.
record.q: Rep. Antonio was recognized at the ceremony for her work on the Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee to improve quality of care and health outcomes for individuals enrolled in the state's Medicaid program.

record.t: Played a key role in gaining legislative approval of language expanding access to syringe exchange programs.
